linux_cli.execution_environment: Native ARM64 instructions in Linux VM/container on ARM64 macOS host; not independent Linux hardware

native_server_indexed.scope: Existing native server validates client indexed pagination, updates, expiry, authorization and large-document scenarios; GLiNER changes verified separately by native fixtures

native_gliner_preparation.scope: Exact monorepo inference module graph, ReleaseSafe, compile-time filter, all selected tests executed directly. Token/marker equivalence, exact-hit reuse, changed question, bounded-retention fallback, complete batched/singleton row equality, task splitting, masks, ranges and token accounting. No model assets or live provider.

codec_coverage_fuzz.scope: Bzip2 malformed-input and codec validation; coverage is reported, not exhaustive conformance

benchmark_normalization.scope: Cross-stream statistics/output comparison; Linux RSS supervisor regression previously qualified separately

labeled_repository_fixture.scope: Ground-truth loopback fixture; not live model relevance

profile.tool: macOS sample, five seconds at one millisecond intervals, symbolized ReleaseFast build
profile.generator: row b"2026-10-15 info worker processed request id=123456 status=success\n" repeated floor(128 MiB / row length), Python bz2.compress defaults
profile.scope: Pre-histogram-fusion decoder, uncommitted CLI fixes; sample is diagnostic attribution, not a throughput measurement
profile.interpretation: Inverse-BWT dependent link traversal and block construction dominate decoder work; fuse histogram accumulation into MTF/RLE symbols to remove one serial content pass, retaining the four-byte links and bounded buffers

limitations: Shared host with unrelated workspace builds; reports retain paired trials and load, and are not portable guarantees.
Linux runs use a VM/container on this ARM64 macOS host. Independent Linux hardware and Windows runtime conformance were not available.
No live provider or encoder latency benchmark: task/text tokenization reuse is fixture-validated and does not reuse bidirectional activations.
Main PR CI remains subject to commit-specific human approval.
